about: The crypt's start room (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB8): the small safe slab the hub's stone brings the party to, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones in the dark, its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), a socket on each side for the bridges out. No fight stands here. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_start_ground.tscn and its art from this.
